Item: doc-outline
**Actual:** fail
Story:
id: doc-outline
title: Document Outline On Demand
as_a: Claude User
i_want: Claude to list the headings of a shared Google Doc when I ask for its outline
so_that: I can see how the document is organised before I read it
status: PLANNED
acceptance_criteria:
    - id: AC-1
      description: Claude must display every heading of a shared Google Doc, in document order, when the Claude User asks for its outline.
      steps:
        - given:
            - a Google Doc with 3 headings is shared with the Claude User
        - when:
            - the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document
        - then:
            - Claude displays an outline of 3 headings
    - id: AC-2
      description: Claude must display the message "This document has no headings" and offer a summary instead when the Claude User asks for the outline of a document without headings.
      steps:
        - given:
            - a Google Doc with no headings is shared with the Claude User
        - when:
            - the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document
        - then:
            - Claude displays the message "This document has no headings"
            - and: Claude offers to summarise the document instead
    - id: AC-3
      description: Claude must display the message "This document is not shared with your account" when the Claude User asks for the outline of a document they cannot open.
      steps:
        - given:
            - a Google Doc that is not shared with the Claude User
        - when:
            - the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document
        - then:
            - Claude displays the message "This document is not shared with your account"

Findings:

- AC-1 given step "a Google Doc with 3 headings is shared with the Claude User": linked to shared document; threshold 9; scores {"shared document":10}; reason: A Google Doc holding a stated number of headings (3) and shared with the Claude User's account — the first branch of the concept, word for word.; other block: none

- AC-1 when step "the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document": linked to outline request; threshold 9; scores {"outline request":10}; reason: The Claude User asks Claude for the outline of the Google Doc in the conversation — a plain instance of the outline request.; other block: none

- AC-1 then step "Claude displays an outline of 3 headings": linked to reply; threshold 9; scores {"reply":10}; reason: Claude's reply lists exactly a stated number of headings (3) as an outline, which the glossary fixes as the headings in document order — the first branch of reply.; other block: none

- AC-2 given step "a Google Doc with no headings is shared with the Claude User": linked to shared document; threshold 9; scores {"shared document":10}; reason: A Google Doc with "no" headings, i.e. none, shared with the Claude User's account — the first branch of the concept, including the stated "no" case.; other block: none

- AC-2 when step "the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document": linked to outline request; threshold 9; scores {"outline request":10}; reason: The Claude User asks Claude for the outline of the Google Doc in the conversation — a plain instance of the outline request.; other block: none

- AC-2 then step "Claude displays the message \"This document has no headings\"": linked to reply; threshold 9; scores {"reply":10}; reason: Claude's reply is exactly the stated message "This document has no headings" — the second branch of reply.; other block: none

- AC-2 then step "Claude offers to summarise the document instead": no concept of then reaches the threshold; threshold 9; scores {"reply":4}; reason: An offer to summarise is a then-kind outcome in the conversation, but reply is closed to two variations — listing a stated number of headings in document order, or being exactly a stated message — and an offer of a different action is neither; no other block's concept covers it either.; other block: none

- AC-3 given step "a Google Doc that is not shared with the Claude User": linked to shared document; threshold 9; scores {"shared document":9}; reason: A Google Doc not shared with the Claude User is, in other words, a Google Doc that account cannot open — the second branch of the concept, phrased from the sharing side rather than the opening side.; other block: none

- AC-3 when step "the Claude User asks Claude to outline the document": linked to outline request; threshold 9; scores {"outline request":10}; reason: The Claude User asks Claude for the outline of the Google Doc in the conversation — a plain instance of the outline request; the unopenable target does not change the concept.; other block: none
